entries.name: WATCHTRADERHUB_API_KEY
entries.description: A WatchTraderHub custom integration API key, sent as a bearer token to read the dealer's published listings, spare parts and reported orders. The key has no scopes, so it could also report or cancel orders and upsert customers; the connector only ever sends GET requests.
howToGet: The dealer needs WatchTraderHub's Business plan, which includes the custom integration.

In the dealer dashboard, open Sales Channels, Custom Integration, then the Settings tab, and click Generate API key. Enable the integration; it starts in test mode, which still shows the real inventory.
WatchTraderHub shows the key, which is wth_ and 32 letters and digits, only once: copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

If the dealer's own site already uses the custom integration, it has the only key: regenerating one turns the old key off at once, so share the site's key through the secret store, or plan the switch with whoever runs the site.
